summary: The proof correctly verifies the numerical range of the fixed constant, handles the zero-mass case, and for positive mass exhausts the two core-capacity branches. In the low-core branch, the accepted dimension obstruction rules out failure of the aggregate-capacity threshold when d is at most 199, so the accepted depth implication applies. The passage from the strict supremal depth bound to a witnessing mixed-integer point and the fiberwise identification with mixed-integer Hausdorff measure are valid, yielding the claimed weak inequality with the stated quantifier order.
